sceneDescription: Ijo ej jutak kin Helia node eo an browser in. Node ko rekilmeej rej kiiō kone ñan browser eo im ewōr juon aer line ñan center eo. Violet node ko kar loe jen browser routing ak rejjab kone. Gold node ko rej kōtaan ko rekar bellok jen Kubo daemon eo ejenolok; rejjab browser connections im ejelok line ñan center in. Slate dead stars rej kejbãrok bwebwenato ko rejjab kobalok, im line in kein kamool ko air rej jolok wõt elikin air kobalok. joñan ettol jen center eo ej joñe latency eo; peer ko rejjab joñe rej bōk orbit eo itulik, im angle ko rej kobaik transport eo kar loe. Iju ko ilo background rejjab jutak kin ro jet. Orbit eo edik ej kakōlkōl Kubo field eo kar bōktok im ejjab juon kōtaan. Juon tōrerein relay ej walok wōt ñe ID in relay eo ej bed ilo peer set eo kar lale; peer-to-peer topology ejjab maroñ in kōmmane. Kōjerbal peer explorer eo ñan ejja melele eo wot ilo text form.
